title: JSFL library/element gaps: useCount, lockItem, editItem, getSelectedText, getTransformationPoint
description:
Add missing JSFL surface to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. library.useCount(item: any): number — iterate all scenes/layers/keyframes/displayObjects, count SymbolInstances whose symbolId matches the item's id. Return the count.

2. library.lockItem(name: string): void — console.warn stub returning void.

3. library.unlockItem(name: string): void — console.warn stub returning void.

4. library.editItem(name: string): boolean — console.warn stub, return true.

5. doc.getSelectedText(): string — find the first selected TextDisplayObject, return its text field value. Return '' if no text selected.

6. doc.setSelectedText(text: string): void — find first selected TextDisplayObject, call updateDisplayObject to set its text content.

7. element.getTransformationPoint(): {x: number, y: number} — add to makeElementProxy getter, returns the element's transformation point. If the element has a transformX/transformY field use those, otherwise return {x: 0, y: 0}.

Add all to their respective interfaces (JsflLibrary, JsflDocument, JsflElement).
